title: Gate a change whose proof run is attested
statement: Whenever Proof run attested, then Gate a change MUST, at its next run for that commit, read the attestation in the CI provider's attestation store, verify it, and gate the change against it.

title: Build the image from the built application
statement: Whenever Application built, then Build the image MUST, at its next run, read the build record the application build wrote and build the image from the recorded executable only.

title: Sign the built image
statement: Whenever Image built, then Sign the image MUST, at its next run, read the image record at the built digest and sign that digest with the provider's trusted signer.

title: Publish only a signed image
statement: Whenever Image signed, then Publish the image MUST, at its next run, read the signature at the image digest and publish the image only when the signature verifies. An unsigned image MUST NOT be published.

title: Supersede the previous digest of a released version
statement: Whenever Component version released, then Supersede a component digest MUST, at its next run for that component, read the release record in the registry, record the digest of the previous version as superseded by the digest of the released version, and set the fail date to the release date plus the window of the component's stage in the registry: alpha 0 months, beta 3 months, ga 6 months, doubled when taking the successor needs a declaration change. A platform engineer MAY shorten the fail date by hand.

title: Supersede the digest a graduated component takes over
statement: Whenever Component graduated to ga, then Supersede a component digest MUST, at its next run, read the component's registry record, and when the graduated component takes over a port name that another component provided, record each digest of that component as superseded by the graduated digest, with needs declaration change set to yes and the fail date at the graduation date plus twice the window of the superseded component's stage.

title: Withdraw every digest of a withdrawn component
statement: Whenever Component withdrawn, then Withdraw a component digest MUST, at its next run, read the withdrawal record in the registry and record every digest of the component as withdrawn, with the reason the registry gives and the date and time of the withdrawal.

title: Verify a qualified release once it is published
statement: Whenever Compiler release qualified, then Verify a published compiler release MUST, at its next run for that commit, read the qualification record in the result folder and verify the published release against it: the tag, each asset digest and the release notes.

title: Qualify a release that was published
statement: Whenever Compiler release published, then Qualify a compiler release MUST, in the same CI run for that commit, read the passed release decision attested at the commit, verify it, and qualify the published release through the consumer path; a release with no passed decision MUST fail qualification.

title: Publish a release whose decision passed
statement: Whenever Release decided with a passed decision for a commit on main, then Publish a compiler release MUST publish that commit's release in the same CI run, and a decision that did not pass MUST publish nothing.

title: The delivery check refuses an image built on a withdrawn digest
statement: Whenever Component digest withdrawn, then Check a delivery candidate MUST, at its next run, read the advisories in the registry and refuse an image whose build record pins the withdrawn digest, naming the digest and the advisory.

title: Move every pipeline pin to a verified compiler release
statement: Whenever Published compiler release verified, then Write the delivery pipeline MUST, at each service's next run, read the verification record of the release and move the service's pipeline pin to that release, as the one change to the CI file, so that the release reaches every service as ST-DLV-UC04 states.

title: Check each published image against the delivery policy
statement: Whenever Image published, then Check a delivery candidate MUST, at its next run in the provider's pipeline, read the build record and the OCI referrers at the published digest, evaluate the delivery policy, and refuse the image when any check fails. The platform's gate MUST enforce the same policy from the policy file the pipeline carries.

title: Plan reports the standing of each superseded pin
statement: Whenever Component digest superseded, then Make a plan MUST, at its next run in each service, read the advisories in the registry, report the standing of each pin the service holds with its successor and its fail date, and refuse a pin past its fail date unless the author overrides it by name, as ST-GEN-INV15 states.

title: Plan refuses a withdrawn pin
statement: Whenever Component digest withdrawn, then Make a plan MUST, at its next run in each service, read the advisories in the registry and refuse a pin to the withdrawn digest, naming the digest, the reason and the fail date, unless the author overrides it by name, as ST-GEN-INV15 states.

title: Introduce a promoted component in the common registry
statement: Whenever Component promoted, then Introduce an experimental component MUST, at the next composition of the common registry, read the promotion record in the registry and add the component at stage alpha, with the sunset date, the outcome it serves, its references and its promise list as the local registry declared them.
